prompt: When calling resolveRuntimeContext with a cwd but no builtinRoot or pluginRoot, the default builtinRoot and pluginRoot paths are resolved relative to the workspace root (cwd). They should instead be resolved relative to the package root where the SDK module file resides, so they remain stable regardless of the working directory. The cacheFilePath default should continue to be relative to the workspace root.
